# technical.pm

> Portfolio and consulting site for Milos Rujevic, Technical Product Manager. Covers technical PM consulting, brand strategy, website/brand-sprint engagements, and building production Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers for agentic platforms.

## Author

Milos Rujevic — Technical Product Manager with 10+ years across financial systems (Red-Black Tree, SAP) and crypto exchange infrastructure (Stellarity DEX). Designs and ships production MCP servers and agent-facing tooling for real platforms.

Contact: magic@technical.pm
Site: https://technical.pm
